methods.name: imitation learning
methods.description: Learning from expert demonstrations to instill agents with a behavioral prior.

methods.name: self-supervised learning
methods.description: Auxiliary training losses used alongside imitation learning to improve agent performance.

methods.name: behavioural cloning

methods.name: contrastive self-supervised representation learning

methods.name: hierarchical action selection
methods.description: An architectural and algorithmic technique improving agent performance.

methods.name: ResNet

methods.name: multi-modal transformer
methods.description: A transformer processing visual and language embeddings.

datasets.name: Playhouse dataset
datasets.description: Dataset collected in the Playhouse environment comprising 275,676 train episodes and 34,399 test episodes.

concepts.name: MIA
concepts.description: Multimodal Interactive Agent designed to interact naturally with humans in a simulated world.

concepts.name: Playhouse
concepts.description: A 3D virtual multi-room environment with randomized rooms and interactable items based on the Unity game engine.

concepts.name: language games
concepts.description: A collection of prompted interaction-types and free-form instructions used to center Playhouse interactions.

findings.name: MIA success rate
findings.description: MIA successfully interacts with non-adversarial humans 75% of the time.

findings.name: behavioral prior efficacy
findings.description: Imitation of multi-modal, real-time human behavior provides a straightforward and effective means of imbuing agents with a rich behavioral prior.
